name: Quote-currency basis hedge
hypothesis: Buy the cheap route, sell the rich route, and hedge the quote-currency exposure using executable synchronized prices.
spec: Setup: Identical token exposure quoted in different currencies may diverge after a currency shock. Entry: Buy the cheap route, sell the rich route, and hedge the quote-currency exposure using executable synchronized prices. Evaluate only information available at decision time; attempt execution afterward. Exit: Exit when the triangular residual closes or hedging fails. Always apply the earlier of the registered maximum holding time and hard risk invalidation; fills can be delayed or unavailable. Parameters to pre-register: eligible universe and point-in-time membership, observation window and completed-event/bar rule, numerical threshold(s) named by the signal, entry order and maximum price/quote deviation, initial invalidation level and target if used, H_max and explicit session definition, cost, impact, latency, failed-attempt, and leg-risk models, position/notional/exit-capacity caps, baseline and out-of-sample rejection thresholds.
blocked_reason: needs funding/basis history and hedged derivative legs (not connected)
